_note: Chromatin accessibility for HFFC6, the input to the HiP-HoP bridging and fibre-compaction terms. DNase-seq. ENCODE has no ATAC-seq for HFFc6, and ENCSR647WPA is archived, so the released ENCSR672EWY is used. Fetch: python -m validation fetch --manifest validation/manifests/HFFC6_accessibility.json --out data/_epigenome  ->  data/_epigenome/HFFC6/. Then bin it onto a bedGraph with: python -m validation tracks --cell HFFC6
